verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API, webhooks, custom channels and UI integrations, and an official MCP server that lets external AI apps act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. Drafts can be created through the API and MCP server, and the pricing page lists API & MCP access. Nothing in the evidence claims UI-API parity, and many UI features (snoozing, canned responses, rules, team chat, assignment, analytics) have no documented API equivalent. MCP coverage appears limited to a subset of objects. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or endpoint coverage of UI features like rules, snoozing, canned responses, chat and assignment; a published OpenAPI spec (all probes returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration of API breadth.
